technology_type.evidence: inferred: NF1 mutant NF9511b pNF cells were treated with BI-2865 for 30 minutes. Cells were washed 3x in ice cold PBS, scraped and pelleted, and snap frozen in dry ice until processing for mass spectrometry. To prepare peptides for phosphoenrichment, cell pellets were lysed in 8 M urea + 25 mM ammonium bicarbonate followed by reduction (5 mM DTT for 1 h at 37 °C), alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature in the dark) and digestion overnight with mass spectrometry grade Trypsin (Promega, #V5111) and Lysyl Endopeptidase (Fujifilm Wako, #125-02543) at a ratio of 100:1 protein to enzyme.
